rows.ARS:
Orange blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: Gary Player
rows.Origin:
Bred by Jan A. Herholdt (South Africa, 1968).
Introduced in United Kingdom by Wheatcroft Brothers Ltd. in 1970 as 'Goliath'.
Introduced by Unknown (Australia) in 1975 as 'Goliath'.
Introduced by Unknown in 1978 as 'Gary Player'.
rows.Bloom: Coral - orange. Mild fragrance. 35 petals. Average diameter 4.5". Double (17-25 petals), high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b and warmer. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
